title: Broken package disallows downloading it again nor deleting it
body: How the issue occured: I downloaded and opened up gnome-disk-utility thru yay tried to mount a disk but all that happened was that my computer froze (possibly due to a separate issue) after rebooting gnome-disk-utility was not usable, couldn't be opened nor showed up on wofi.
